hook: Brynjolfsson has spent three decades building the empirical case for how digital technology, and now AI, actually changes productivity and jobs, work that shifted from academic papers to boardroom strategy as generative AI forced every company to ask the same question he had been measuring for years.
name: Erik Brynjolfsson

quote.text: We are entering a period in which our destiny is not to compete with machines, but to figure out how to work with them.
quote.context: A theme repeated across Brynjolfsson's writing and talks, including The Second Machine Age, 2014

moniker: Economist of the Second Machine Age

primary.name: Erik Brynjolfsson, Stanford Digital Economy Lab, official bio
The Second Machine Age, Erik Brynjolfsson and Andrew McAfee (W.W. Norton, 2014)

secondary.name: Erik Brynjolfsson, Stanford HAI faculty profile

timeline.event: Earns PhD in managerial economics from MIT
timeline.impact: Establishes his research foundation in technology economics
Becomes a defining text on automation and the economy
Extends the framework to platforms and AI-augmented decision-making

timeline.event: Founds the Stanford Digital Economy Lab
timeline.impact: Institutionalizes empirical research on AI's economic effects
Applies research directly to enterprise AI workforce strategy

quick_facts: Director of the Stanford Digital Economy Lab and Senior Fellow at Stanford HAI
Co-authored The Second Machine Age (2014) and Machine, Platform, Crowd (2017)
Coined and researched the 'productivity paradox' of information technology
Co-founded Workhelix, applying AI economics research to workforce strategy

achievements.title: The Second Machine Age (2014, with Andrew McAfee)
achievements.impact: Became a defining framework for understanding automation's economic disruption, widely read in both academic and business circles.

achievements.title: Research on the productivity paradox and the 'J-curve' of technology adoption
achievements.impact: Explained why transformative technologies often show a lag before productivity gains appear, a framework now applied directly to generative AI adoption.

achievements.title: Founding Director, Stanford Digital Economy Lab
achievements.impact: Built one of the leading research centers studying AI's measurable effects on jobs, productivity, and inequality.

achievements.title: Co-founding Workhelix
achievements.impact: Translated academic AI-economics research into applied workforce-transformation consulting for large employers.
